map.五要素 = 角色 + 任务 + 上下文 + 输出格式 + 约束。完整度只按「该要: The five elements = Role + Task + Context + Output format + Constraints. Completeness only counts whether the element is filled: Role is always filled, each of the other four adds 20 points, so an all-empty form scores 20, not 0. Constraints separated by semicolons auto-split into independent items written into the self-check list; the output item count is clamped between 1 and 20. The result is a copyable text with six sections — Role, Task, Output format, Constraints, Self-check, Banned — and calls no model.
map.任务 = 优化、目标对象 = 落地页文案、输出格式 = 分点列表、约束 = 「每: Task = optimize, Target = landing-page copy, Output format = bulleted list, Constraints = '≤20 chars per line; no exclamation marks', Expected items = 5 → completeness 100 (5/5), expected output count 5; the prompt includes self-check items such as 'Task: optimize the landing-page copy', 'output 5 items as a bulleted list', '≤20 chars per line; no exclamation marks' and 'whether the count equals 5'. Leaving the target empty drops completeness to 60, with a hint 'suggested to fill: Context, Constraints'.
map.完整度评分是怎么算的？: How is the completeness score calculated?
map.只按「要素是否填写」计数，不判断内容质量：角色恒为已填，任务、上下文、输出格式、: Counted only by whether the element is filled, not content quality: Role is always filled, and the four items Task / Context / Output format / Constraints each contribute 20 points. So an all-empty form scores 20, not 0; a full 100 means all five are present.
map.这个工具会调用 AI 生成内容吗？: Does this tool call AI to generate content?
map.不会。它只把五要素拼装成一段结构化提示词文本并做完整度自检，不联网、不调用任何模: No. It only assembles the five elements into a structured prompt text and runs a completeness self-check — no network, no model calls. You then copy the prompt into your own AI tool to execute.
map.输出条数怎么限制？: How is the output item count limited?
map.输入框的值会被钳制在 1~20 之间：填 0 或非法值回退为 1，填 99 也按: The input value is clamped between 1 and 20: 0 or invalid falls back to 1, and 99 is treated as 20, so the prompt never asks for an unrealistic count.

【Role】You are a senior product and design expert.
【Task】Run generation for the "Workout complete" screen of a fitness app.
【Output format】Output 3 items as a bulleted list with no repeated meaning between items.
【Constraints】No more than 12 characters; avoid exclamation marks; aimed at office workers aged 25-35.
【Self-check】Before answering, check each item: ① is the count equal to 3; ② do they meet all the constraints above; ③ do they give an actionable next step.
【Forbidden】Do not output generic filler unrelated to the "Workout complete" screen of a fitness app.
